summary.value: Hotel Belleclaire Central Park is a storied NYC hotel on the Upper West Side, where timeless architecture meets modern comfort near Central Park and Lincoln Center, at Hotel Belleclaire, 2175 Broadway. It suits travelers who want a residential base over Midtown bustle, with a 24-hour fitness center, walking tours, wine hours, and dog-friendly stays, and booking direct adds a Daily dining credit to Mille-Feuille. Trip.com guests sum it up as a “Beautiful hotel, very well located, tidy and good service”. Honest watch-outs: the facilities are somewhat lacking, especially the soundproofing, and the lift is small (“The elevator is extremely small”).

description.value: Hotel Belleclaire Central Park sits at 2175 Broadway on the Upper West Side. The hotel lists a 24-hour fitness center, walking tours, wine hours, and dog-friendly stays among its amenities. Hotel Belleclaire Central Park puts guests near Central Park and Lincoln Center, with Zabar's and the subway close by. Trip.com shows 7.3 / 10 128 reviews. Representative Trip.com praise (guest reviews): “Beautiful hotel, very well located, tidy and good service”. Representative watch-outs: “the facilities are somewhat lacking, especially the soundproofing”; “The elevator is extremely small, only able to accommodate a maximum of 4 people”.
